  - **< 10 ms TTFB**: Built `devpic`, a stateless mathematical SVG REST API executing on Next.js Edge Runtime with zero database dependencies.

## Key Open Source & Production Systems
- **Digital Commerce & Entitlement Platform** ([store.sowebuild.in](https://store.sowebuild.in)): Dual-verification checkout (synchronous API + timing-safe HMAC-SHA256 webhook) and AES-256-GCM encryption at rest with randomized IVs.
- **devpic — Stateless Mathematical SVG API** ([github.com/MonsterFlick/devpic](https://github.com/MonsterFlick/devpic)): Open-source, zero-dependency REST API generating deterministic SVG meshes in <10ms on Next.js Edge Runtime.
- **Agni — Local AI Automation Agent** ([github.com/MonsterFlick/Agni](https://github.com/MonsterFlick/Agni)): Offline Windows automation agent powered by local Ollama models with regex command blacklisting and self-repairing execution loops.
- **Fin Read — Offline-First Finance Tracker** ([github.com/MonsterFlick/Fin-Read](https://github.com/MonsterFlick/Fin-Read)): Android Kotlin expense tracker extracting SMS transactions into Room Database with idempotent Supabase cloud synchronization.
- **GitFool** ([blogs.omthakur.in](https://blogs.omthakur.in)): Edge-runtime publication platform compiling markdown directly from GitHub repositories via webhooks with sub-30ms TTFB.
